implementation: Independent source reconstruction from the local stock M68 module, its relocation-annotated ARM64 disassembly, local firmware and M2391 MP device tree. No F71 or other confidential public-source implementation is copied.
safety_changes: Checked short I2C transfers and allocation errors; bounded firmware and raw I/O sizes.
Serialized complete mailbox and firmware transactions.
Drained sysfs, misc, panel notifier, IRQ, thread and work before freeing resources; retained open-file state using kref.
Replaced NULL sscanf / calibration-overwriting logging with safe legacy binary logging record updates; ASCII calibration is retained.
Bounded hex parser does not modify const sysfs input or overwrite token boundaries.
Initialized the original one-byte EEPROM diagnostic output instead of exposing an unwritten byte.
Balanced repeated IRQ disable/enable aliases and propagated failed writes.
